// diagnostic

E0212

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

What

An owner is moved, replaced, or resized while a live view still points into it.

Why

The operation could move or destroy the storage that the view reads or edits; Jet rejects before lowering instead of relying on a backend borrow error.

Fix

Finish using the view before changing the owner, narrow the view's scope, or make an owned copy.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0212: tests/ui/taskgroup_overlapping_write_borrows.stderr.

Error [E0320]: inferred record construction uses `{…}`, not `.{…}`
  --> tests/ui/taskgroup_overlapping_write_borrows.jet:8:9
    |
  8 |         .{position: 10, velocity: 2},
    |         ^
 Why: D-LIT-DOT1 drops the constructor dot from every literal head
 Fix: write `{…}`

Error [E0212]: `particles[…]` already has a live view that conflicts with `two`
  --> tests/ui/taskgroup_overlapping_write_borrows.jet:13:9
    |
 13 |         two :: &particles[0]
    |         ^^^
 Why: many read views may overlap, but an exclusive mutable view cannot overlap any other live view
 Fix: finish using the earlier view before creating this one, or make an owned copy
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0212

Error [E1101]: `two` and `one` can reach the same place at the same time
  --> tests/ui/taskgroup_overlapping_write_borrows.jet:16:13
    |
 16 |             { two.position += 1; two.position }
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: a task.group runs its children at the same time, so two children may borrow one place only when the compiler can prove the places never overlap
 Fix: give it with `^`, freeze it with `freeze`, or share it with `shared`; in a group, borrow separate fields or constant indexes
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1101
